description:
Quiet Night Music | Slow Bansuri Flute | 3 Hours

It's Sunday night. The week ahead is already knocking, and the house has finally gone quiet — except your mind.

You don't need another 20-minute track that ends just as you start to drift. This is three full hours of slow bamboo flute — long enough to carry you through falling asleep and keep holding the room after you're under. No interruptions, no sudden changes, nothing to follow. Just one long, unhurried breath of sound.

The Bansuri is the Indian bamboo flute — soft, breath-driven, rising and falling like a slow exhale. Underneath it, a low tanpura drone holds the room steady. The music is built on Raga Darbari Kanada, the midnight raga — the heaviest, slowest, most gravity-bound sound in Indian classical music. It doesn't ask for your attention. It lowers the floor of the room.

Set the volume low, turn off the lights, and let it outlast you.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Bansuri — slow, breath-driven bamboo flute with long pauses between phrases
- Raga Darbari Kanada — the deep midnight raga, heavy and still
- A low tanpura drone holding everything underneath
- No tabla, no percussion — just flute, drone, and space
- 3 unbroken hours at 432Hz tuning with a soft delta undertone for sleep

⏱ Chapters
0:00     Lights off
30:00    The mind slowing down
1:00:00  Drifting under
1:45:00  Deep night
2:30:00  Holding the room
2:55:00  Quiet close

🧠 How to use:
Lie down in the dark and set the volume just loud enough to soften the silence. Don't listen to it — let it sit in the corner of the room like a lamp turned low. If you wake in the night, it will still be there.

⏱ Best for:
• Sleepless nights and Sunday-night overthinking
• Falling asleep without a track ending mid-drift
• Staying asleep — 3 hours covers the light-sleep window
• Night shifts winding down, jet lag, late reading

production_spec.notes: DURATION OVERRIDE: 180 min (not the 90 default) — 3hr is the point of this ship (long-session sleep lane per Finding 12; only second 3hr on channel). Raga Darbari Kanada — deep midnight raga (komal Ga and komal Dha with slow andolan oscillation = the heavy midnight gravity). DELIBERATELY NOT Yaman: Jun 5 Yaman sleep ship died on AVD 12:28; Darbari is structurally slower and darker, and differentiates the music from both the May 7 hero and Jun 5 (all Yaman). TABLA: none, per banked Bansuri rule. BPM floor 45-52 — slower than Jun 5's 50-60; the AVD failure countermeasure is SLOWER + SPARSER, more silence between phrases, flute sitting lower in register. Binaural Delta 3Hz at -20dB added in POST only (never in Suno prompt). LUFS -18. 180 min = loop more clips, but sleep listeners are drifting — seams forgiving. AVD WATCH: this is the retention-fix ship. If AVD fails again at <18% with CTR fine, the Suno sleep recipe itself is broken — escalate per failure_mode. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION (one per clip): 'like the night breathing slower until it stops asking anything of you' · 'the last lamp in the house burning low' · 'the room lowering its own floor' · 'three hours of nobody needing you'.
